ai-detector-false-positives

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:ai-detector-false-positives` → `ai-ai-detector-false-positives` → `src/demos/ai/ai-ai-detector-false-positives`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/207`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30f.md#23-ai-detector-false-positives`. **Packet:** P1. **Level / prerequisites:** core; `ai:accuracy-paradox`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** accuracy-paradox uses base-rate alerts; this adds authorship abstention and shows how a declared high-threshold protocol changes both precision and undecided volume.

**Computed primary model:** Fictional10000texts, machine prevalence.01. Declared detectorTPR.9/FPR.05 gives expected trueflags90,falseflags495, positiveposterior90/585=2/13≈.153846. Atprevalence.5 same rates give18/19≈.947368. These are expected counts under stipulated rates, not observed detector validation.

**Countercase / boundary:** Three score regions: highmachine.6/human.01; mediummachine.3/human.04; lowmachine.1/human.95. Baselineflags high+medium, matching.9/.05. Protocolflags high, abstainsmedium: trueflags60,falseflags99, positiveposterior20/53≈.377358, abstentions30+396=426. Better positiveprecision here costs undecided cases and lowerTPR; neither protocol proves an individual’s authorship.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether most initial flags must be machine-written; recall same rates at a different prevalence produce a different posterior and abstention is not a negative judgement.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Change prevalence/Allow abstention recomputes full expected contingency table and denominator, retaining original90/495 flags and new60/99/426 evidence. No accusation or real writing sample is classified.

**Source obligation:** Declared finite construction and reproduced arithmetic support only this toy. Independently derive every visible claim; acquire an original method body with exact locator before adding generalized performance, history or empirical assertions. Before a real detector accuracy, population or fairness statement, acquire dated original validation protocol/data and exact model/version; none is inferred from these toy rates.
